basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and Ni No Kuni enthusiast living in Oregon. I work as a postal clerk for USPS, which keeps me on my feet and provides plenty of downtime to dive into RPGs. Married to my high school sweetheart, and we have a lovable golden retriever named Max. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, especially active on weekends. Apart from gaming, I have a keen interest in Star Trek: The Next Generation and enjoy discussing the finer points of canine behavior.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I developed my knowledge of Ni No Kuni through countless hours of gameplay and by participating in dedicated gaming communities online. My role at USPS has honed my organizational skills, which I apply when strategizing Kingdom building in the game. I'm also a self-taught expert on Star Trek lore, having watched every episode multiple times.
